title: "At least 7 instructions are needed to pack a 5:6:5 RGB value" -- prove or refute
statement: The only bare lower-bound claim found in any ISA specification (Bitmanip v0.93 §4.1.3). No proof exists. QF_BV over RV64I with a declared immediate pool; a 6-instruction program or a DRAT at k=6. Effort estimate: weeks.
